# 起源心金 (Origin HeartGold) v4.0.3: player documentation

These pages are **generated** from the hack's own ROM data (`work/rom/origin_v4.0.3_cn.nds`, the untouched Chinese
v4.0.3), not from the author's spreadsheets or other websites. English names come from this project's translation
workspace (`work/translate/banks`) and glossary, so they match the English patch.

Regenerate after any change to the ROM reader or the name banks:

```
python3 work/tools/docs/gen_docs.py          # writes work/docs/*.md and work/notes/docs_crossref.md
python3 work/tools/docs/gen_docs.py --check  # exit 1 if a page would change
python3 -m unittest work/tools/docs/test_gen_docs.py
```

  hidden), base stats, evolutions, level-up moves, TM/HM, tutor and egg moves, and how to get each species.
- [moves.md](moves.md): move data and the TM/HM list.
- [encounters.md](encounters.md): wild Pokémon per map and method, Headbutt trees, Bug-Catching Contest.
- [items.md](items.md): key/quest items, field and hidden items, NPC gifts, shops, prize and paid exchanges.
- [trainers.md](trainers.md): Gym challenges in guide order, other named opponents and allies, then ordinary
  trainers by map, with full teams and separate unconfirmed records.
- [trades_tutors.md](trades_tutors.md): in-game trades, move tutors, the Move Reminder, gift Pokémon and one-time
  battles.

## The author's own notes (maintainer-local)

English versions of the hack author's spreadsheets are kept in `author_notes/` on maintainers' machines only: that
folder is not in the public repository (it holds third-party text). They are static translations (gen_docs.py does
not touch them); `work/notes/spreadsheet_crossref.md` cross-checks them row by row against these ROM-generated pages.

## Data sources

The hack is hg-engine-like (1,441 species slots, new move table, custom trainer format) but not stock hg-engine.
Each table below was located by the code that reads it (the arm9 NARC loader at `0x02007424` and the functions
named), not by the vanilla file names.

| Data | Where the game reads it | Format notes |
|---|---|---|
| Species (stats, types, abilities, hidden ability, egg groups…) | `a/0/0/2`, NARC 2 | 52-byte records; abilities are u16 at 0x16/0x18, hidden ability u16 at 0x1A; no TM bits |
| Alternate forms | arm9 `0x020FEDC0`, 415 × {species, personal index, form} | form lookup at `0x020721C0` |
| Level-up learnsets | `a/0/3/3`, NARC 33 | u16 (level, move) pairs, `0xFFFF` end; level 0 = on evolution |
| Evolutions | `a/0/3/4`, NARC 34 | 10 × {method, parameter, target}; method ids inferred from use (see below) |
| TM/HM moves | arm9 `0x020FFFF8` (TM01–HM08) and `0x020FFFAC` (TM93–TM130) | `TMHMGetMove` at `0x02076688` |
| TM compatibility | `data/tutor_moves.narc`, NARC 273 | u16 move list per species; the check at `0x02071464` also accepts any level-up move, Return for all, everything for Mew |
| Tutor compatibility | species lists inside each tutor script (`a/0/1/2`) | `GetPartyMonSpecies` + `CompareVarToValue` chain |
| Egg moves | `data/egg_moves.narc`, NARC 272 (same data as `a/2/2/9`) | u16 list |
| Moves | `extra/new_move_data.narc`, NARC 276 | see `work/notes/move_data_audit.md`; `a/0/1/1` is dead data |
| Items | `a/0/1/7` | 34-byte records: price u16 at 0, pocket in the word at 8 |
| Wild encounters | `a/0/3/7`, NARC 37 | pret `EncounterData` (0xC4 bytes) |
| Headbutt | `a/2/5/2`, one member per map | pret `HeadbuttEncounterData` |
| Bug-Catching Contest | `data/mushi/mushi_encount.bin` | 4 × 10 slots |
| Trainers | `a/0/5/5` (20-byte header) and `a/0/5/6` | parties are a fixed 28 bytes per Pokémon (hack format) |
| In-game trades | `a/1/1/2`, names in bank 0198 | pret `NPCTrade` (0x54 bytes) |
| Hidden items | arm9 `0x020F7194`, 231 × 8 bytes | bg events with script 8000+n |
| Item balls | script file 141 (std script 7000) | map objects with script 7000+n |
| Shops | arm9 `0x0210EAEC` (54 lists, `SpecialMartBuy`); list 3 is replaced by the fixed list at `0x020F8B3E` | `SpecialMartBuy` at `0x0204787C`, called through std 2052 with the list id in 0x8004; the badge-tier list at `0x020F8D3A` (`MartBuy`, std 2048–2050) is never called |
| Map → location name | `work/translate/bank_maps.json` (map header table) | |

Evolution method ids 1–33 were matched to their meaning by the species that use them (e.g. 27 is "knows a
Fairy-type move" for Sylveon, 28/29 are day/night level-ups). Ids 34–41 (Gimmighoul, Kubfu, Galarian Yamask,
Basculin, Pawmo, Rellor, Finizen) are shown as "special condition", with the official games' condition as a hint;
the hack's own check for them is not confirmed.

## Method and limits

- Everything is read by `work/tools/docs/romdata.py` (parsers) and rendered by `gen_docs.py`. Scripts are
  disassembled with the command table in `work/tools/docs/script_cmds.json` (pret names, hack's 843 commands).
- Script-derived facts (gifts, prices, tutor payments, trainer branch conditions) come from constant values in
  the scripts. Values computed at run time are shown as unknown or left out.
- Not covered: berry and apricorn trees, the Safari Zone's object-based areas, Pokéwalker routes, Battle Frontier sets,
  roaming Pokémon and swarm schedules (the swarm species per map are listed).
- The cross-reference of these docs against the scripts and dialogue is `work/notes/docs_crossref.md`; the
  cross-check against the author's spreadsheets is `work/notes/spreadsheet_crossref.md`.
- Page sizes (for maintainers): encounters.md 179 KB, items.md 89 KB, moves.md 62 KB, pokemon.md 169 KB, pokemon_0001-0151.md 310 KB, pokemon_0152-0251.md 205 KB, pokemon_0252-0386.md 276 KB, pokemon_0387-0493.md 218 KB, pokemon_0494-0649.md 287 KB, pokemon_0650-0721.md 138 KB, pokemon_0722-0809.md 159 KB, pokemon_0810-0905.md 164 KB, pokemon_0906-1025.md 189 KB, pokemon_1026-1440.md 796 KB, trades_tutors.md 26 KB, trainers.md 763 KB.
